status: proposed, not an implemented parser/API schema
invariants: Legacy scores need no annotations and retain existing event digests.
Comments, definitions and control flow survive structural edits.
Variable rebinding and value-copy semantics are preserved.
Repeat references are finite, acyclic and within expansion budgets.
Duration follows resolved meter and tempo maps, including conditional children.
No implicit tiling of a part marked through-composed.
New written occurrences are authored and stored before playback.
Playback, seek and loop-count changes do not reroll accepted material.
Local edits do not alter other occurrences.
Ancestor locks cannot be weakened by child context or AI output.
Applied candidates must match their recorded source revision.
